compositionDate.note: The date is traditional; the inscription itself carries a cyclical year but no reign title or name.

backgroundZh: 这是一篇刻在崖上的悼鹤铭。作者署别号，年代用干支；石曾坠入长江，后以残块捞起。残字犹存，遂为后世习大字者所重。
background: A cliff elegy for a crane, signed with a sobriquet rather than a name, and dated by a cyclical year. It fell into the Yangtze, was recovered in fragments, and became the model for large-character calligraphy.

review.note: Owner approved for publication on 2026-11-18. Pre-approval evidence note: Draft work record. Both the date and the attribution are disputed in the cited sources; the record preserves the dispute.
review.noteZh: 项目负责人于 2026-11-18 审核并同意发布。审核前的证据记录：草稿记录。所引材料对年代与书者均有异说，本条保留争议。

notes: The cited sources list several candidate authors (王羲之, 陶弘景, 顾况, 王瓒) without settling the question.
